## 1. Overview

### Project Summary

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Application | Foundry - Multi-tenant SaaS for AI Training Data Preparation |
| Tech Stack | React + Vite + TypeScript (Frontend), Express.js + TypeScript (Backend) |
| Database | PostgreSQL via Neon with Drizzle ORM |
| UI Library | shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS v4 |
| Authentication | JWT with bcrypt password hashing |
| Deployment | Replit (Port 5000) |

#### .env.example

```bash
# ===========================================
# REQUIRED - App will not start without these
# ===========================================
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@host:5432/database
JWT_SECRET=your-jwt-secret-min-32-characters-here
SESSION_SECRET=your-session-secret-min-32-chars-here

# ===========================================
# REQUIRED WITH DEFAULTS - Override if needed
# ===========================================
# PORT ARCHITECTURE:
# - Development: Vite on 5000 (Replit exposed), Express on 3001 (internal)
#   Vite proxies /api/* to Express on 3001
# - Production: Express on 5000 serves both static files and API
#   Replit automatically sets PORT=5000
PORT=3001
NODE_ENV=development

# ===========================================
# OPTIONAL - Features degrade gracefully
# ===========================================
# Email sending (disabled if not set - invitations logged to console)
RESEND_API_KEY=

# Teamwork Desk integration
# Credentials are stored per-connection, encrypted in database
```

## 3. Task List (Ordered by Dependency)

### Phase 1: Foundation (SETUP Tasks)

```
TASK-001: Project initialization and configuration
Type: SETUP
Source: Architecture - Environment
Dependencies: None
Files: package.json, tsconfig.json, tsconfig.server.json, .env.example, .replit, replit.nix
Description: Initialize project with all configuration files using Replit-native patterns
Replit Notes: Ensure PORT defaults, tsx scripts for Drizzle, Vite 0.0.0.0 binding
Acceptance Criteria:
  - [ ] npm install completes without errors
  - [ ] TypeScript compiles without errors
  - [ ] Environment validation runs on startup
Estimated Hours: 2
```

```
TASK-002: Database connection setup
Type: SETUP
Source: Architecture - Database
Dependencies: TASK-001
Files: server/db/index.ts, server/config/env.ts, drizzle.config.ts
Description: Configure postgres-js driver with Drizzle ORM and connection pooling
Replit Notes: Use postgres package NOT @neondatabase/serverless; max 10 connections
Acceptance Criteria:
  - [ ] Database connects on server start
  - [ ] Connection pool configured (max: 10, idle_timeout: 20)
  - [ ] Graceful shutdown closes connections
Estimated Hours: 2
```

```
TASK-003: Replit configuration verification
Type: SETUP
Source: Architecture - Replit Config
Dependencies: TASK-002
Files: vite.config.ts, server/index.ts
Description: Verify all Replit-specific configurations are correct
Replit Notes: Port 5000, Vite proxy to 3001, static file serving in production
Acceptance Criteria:
  - [ ] Vite dev server binds to 0.0.0.0:5000
  - [ ] Express runs on PORT (3001 dev, 5000 prod)
  - [ ] API proxy works in development
  - [ ] Static files served in production
Estimated Hours: 1
```

```
TASK-004: Error handling infrastructure
Type: SETUP
Source: Architecture - Error Handling
Dependencies: TASK-001
Files: server/errors/index.ts, server/middleware/error-handler.ts, server/lib/validation.ts
Description: Create error class hierarchy and global error handler middleware
Replit Notes: None
Acceptance Criteria:
  - [ ] AppError base class with code, message, statusCode
  - [ ] BadRequestError, NotFoundError, UnauthorizedError, ForbiddenError, ConflictError
  - [ ] Global error handler catches all errors
  - [ ] parseIntParam validates URL parameters
Estimated Hours: 2
```

```
TASK-005: Logging infrastructure
Type: SETUP
Source: Architecture - Observability
Dependencies: TASK-001
Files: server/lib/logger.ts
Description: Configure pino logger for structured logging
Replit Notes: Pretty print in development, JSON in production
Acceptance Criteria:
```

## 4. Development Workflow

### 4.1 Initial Setup (One-time)

```bash
# 1. Clone repository
git clone <repository-url>
cd foundry

# 2. Install dependencies
npm install

# 3. Configure environment
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env with your DATABASE_URL and secrets

# 4. Initialize database
npm run db:push
npm run db:seed

# 5. Start development server
npm run dev
```

### 4.2 Daily Development

```bash
# Start development
npm run dev

# Access app
# Frontend: http://localhost:5000 (Vite)
# API: http://localhost:3001/api (Express, proxied through Vite)

# Run type check
npm run typecheck

# Run linting
npm run lint
```

### 4.3 Database Changes

```bash
# After modifying schema files:
npm run db:generate  # Generate migration files
npm run db:push      # Push changes to database

# For production:
npm run db:migrate   # Run programmatic migration
```

### 4.4 Adding shadcn/ui Components

```bash
# Add a new component
npx shadcn-ui@latest add <component-name>

# Components are added to client/src/components/ui/
```

### 4.5 Build and Deploy

```bash
# Build for production
npm run build

# Test production build locally
npm run start

# Deploy on Replit
# 1. Push to GitHub
# 2. Replit auto-deploys from main branch
# 3. Configure Secrets in Replit (DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, etc.)
```

### 5.5 Route Handler Pattern

```typescript
// server/routes/example.routes.ts
import { Router } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { parseIntParam } from '../lib/validation';
import { requireAuth, requireAdmin } from '../middleware/auth';
import { exampleService } from '../services/example.service';

const router = Router();

const createSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(1).max(200),
  description: z.string().optional(),
});

// List (authenticated)
router.get('/', requireAuth, async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const items = await exampleService.list(req.organisationId);
    res.json({ data: items });
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
});

// Create (authenticated)
router.post('/', requireAuth, async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const data = createSchema.parse(req.body);
    const item = await exampleService.create(req.organisationId, data);
    res.status(201).json({ data: item });
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
});

// Get by ID (authenticated)
router.get('/:id', requireAuth, async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const id = parseIntParam(req.params.id, 'id');
    const item = await exampleService.getById(req.organisationId, id);
    res.json({ data: item });
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
});

// Delete (admin only)
router.delete('/:id', requireAuth, requireAdmin, async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const id = parseIntParam(req.params.id, 'id');
    await exampleService.delete(req.organisationId, id);
    res.status(204).send();
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
});

export { router as exampleRoutes };
```

### 5.6 Service Pattern

```typescript
// server/services/example.service.ts
import { db } from '../db';
import { examples } from '../db/schema';
import { eq, and } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { NotFoundError } from '../errors';

export const exampleService = {
  async list(organisationId: number) {
    return db
      .select()
      .from(examples)
      .where(eq(examples.organisationId, organisationId));
  },

  async getById(organisationId: number, id: number) {
    const [item] = await db
      .select()
      .from(examples)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(examples.id, id),
          eq(examples.organisationId, organisationId)
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    if (!item) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Example', id);
    }

    return item;
  },

  async create(organisationId: number, data: { name: string; description?: string }) {
    const [item] = await db
      .insert(examples)
      .values({ ...data, organisationId })
      .returning();
    return item;
  },

  async delete(organisationId: number, id: number) {
    const [deleted] = await db
      .delete(examples)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(examples.id, id),
          eq(examples.organisationId, organisationId)
        )
      )
      .returning();

    if (!deleted) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Example', id);
    }
  },
};
```

### 5.7 React Page Pattern

```tsx
// client/src/pages/ExamplePage.tsx
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { api } from '@/lib/api';
import { queryKeys } from '@/lib/queryKeys';
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/common/PageHeader';
import { LoadingState } from '@/components/common/LoadingState';
import { ErrorState } from '@/components/common/ErrorState';
import { EmptyState } from '@/components/common/EmptyState';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/useToast';

export function ExamplePage() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const { data, isLoading, error, refetch } = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.examples.list(),
    queryFn: () => api.get('/examples'),
  });

  const createMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (data: { name: string }) => api.post('/examples', data),
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.examples.all });
      toast({ title: 'Created successfully' });
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast({ title: 'Failed to create', variant: 'destructive' });
    },
  });

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState />;
  if (error) return <ErrorState message="Failed to load" onRetry={refetch} />;

  const items = data?.data || [];

  return (
    <div className="p-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="Examples"
        description="Manage your examples"
        action={
          <Button onClick={() => createMutation.mutate({ name: 'New Example' })}>
            Create Example
          </Button>
        }
      />

      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={FileIcon}
          title="No examples yet"
          description="Create your first example to get started"
          action={{ label: 'Create Example', onClick: () => {} }}
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-4">
          {items.map((item) => (
            <div key={item.id}>{item.name}</div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 7. Downstream Agent Handoff Brief

### For Agent 7: QA & Deployment

**Replit Deployment Verification (CRITICAL):**

Before any testing, verify these Replit-specific items:

| Check | Command/Location | Expected |
|-------|------------------|----------|
| Port configuration | `.replit`, `vite.config.ts`, `server/index.ts` | All show 5000 |
| Drizzle migration | `npm run db:push` | Uses tsx wrapper, no prompts |
| Vite binding | `vite.config.ts` | host: '0.0.0.0', allowedHosts: true |
| Static serving | `server/index.ts` | Serves dist/public in production |
| Env vars | Replit Secrets | All REQUIRED vars set |

**Task Verification Checklist:**

For each completed task, verify:
- [ ] All acceptance criteria met
- [ ] Files created as specified
- [ ] No deviation from spec source
- [ ] Replit notes addressed

**Test Categories by Task Type:**

| Task Type | Test Types Required |
|-----------|---------------------|
| SETUP | Smoke test (app starts on Replit) |
| DATA | Migration runs without prompts, model CRUD works |
| API | Unit tests, integration tests, contract tests |
| UI | Component tests, visual regression |
| INTEG | E2E tests on Replit deployment |

**Critical Test Scenarios from PRD:**

1. First-run flow: CSV upload → configure → process → export in < 5 minutes
2. Teamwork Desk connection with invalid credentials → appropriate error
3. Processing with 100,000 records → completes successfully
4. De-identification consistency → same name = same placeholder
5. Role-based access → member vs admin capabilities
6. Session persistence → 7-day JWT works
7. Concurrent users → no data isolation issues

**Deployment Steps (Replit-Specific):**

1. Push code to GitHub
2. Connect Replit to GitHub repository
3. Configure Secrets (DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, SESSION_SECRET)
4. Run `npm install`
5. Run `npm run db:push` (verify no interactive prompts)
6. Run `npm run build`
7. Run `npm run start`
8. Verify health endpoint: GET /api/health
